title: Sar3kezm HUB  staff
features:
👷 Main Features (Main Tab)

Auto Hire - Automatically hire workers (Collector & Repairer) with a single click.

Auto Buy Machines - Instantly buy all available Arcade machines from 1 to 10.

Auto Expand Store - Automatically purchase the next expansions for your arcade.

Auto Kick - Kicks all players from the server and automatically kicks anyone who joins.

Kick All - Instantly kicks all players except for you.

Built-in Tools - Quick access to popular scripts like Infinite Yield and DEX.

🚀 Player Features (Player Tab)

Walkspeed Modifier - Adjust your character's movement speed with a slider.

Anti-AFK - Prevents you from being kicked for inactivity, keeping you in the server.

Unlock Jump - Forces the ability to jump, even if the game disables it.

🗺 Server Features (Servers Tab)

Server Info - Displays the server's ID, player count, ping, and estimated region.

Server Hop - Instantly teleport to a different, random server.

Small Server Finder - The script will automatically hop through servers until it 
finds one with less than 5 players—perfect for playing alone!
